display.purpose: Hero headlines, landing page mastheads. One per page.

headline.purpose: Section titles, page headers. Serif italic for editorial emphasis.

body.purpose: Body copy, descriptions. Max 65-75ch line length.

label.purpose: Data labels, metadata, timestamps, tab labels. Always uppercase, wide tracking.

shadows.name: structural
shadows.purpose: Modals, command palettes, drawers. Heavy, diffuse, grounded.

shadows.name: ambient-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary button hover, active states. Subtle red aura.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: Cards, panels, nav, content surfaces. Flat. Depth via background color only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The primary action. Blood red, uppercase, sharp. Used sparingly.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ff2b2b; color: #f5f3f0; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ff4848; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff2b2b; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent with border. Hover brightens.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #a6a19a; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid #2e2929; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #3a3333; color: #f5f3f0; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff2b2b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form input. Sharp, 2px border, surface background.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #0f0d0d; color: #f5f3f0; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; border: 2px solid #2e2929; border-radius: 0; outline: none; transition: border-color 200ms; width: 100%; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #4a4540; font-style: italic; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #ff2b2b; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Content container. Sharp, 2px border, surface background.
components.html:
Card Title

Card content goes here.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #0f0d0d; color: #f5f3f0; padding: 24px; border: 2px solid #221f1f; border-radius: 0; transition: border-color 200ms, transform 200ms; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #3a3333; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Bodoni Moda', serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0 0 12px 0; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.65; color: #a6a19a; margin: 0; }

components.name: Navigation Tab
components.description: Tab navigation. Mono label, ash default, red underline on active.
components.html: ActiveInactive
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 2px; } .ds-nav-tab { padding: 8px 14px; font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: -0.005em; color: #6b6660; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; position: relative; transition: color 200ms; } .ds-nav-tab:hover { color: #f5f3f0; } .ds-nav-tab-active { color: #f5f3f0; } .ds-nav-tab-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 14px; right: 14px; bottom: -1px; height: 2px; background: #ff2b2b; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255, 43, 43, 0.35); }

components.name: LangBadge
components.description: Language indicator. Colored dot + mono label. Lowercase.
components.css: .ds-lang-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 2px 7px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #7ed5d0; border: 1px solid rgba(126, 213, 208, 0.2); background: rgba(126, 213, 208, 0.05); text-transform: lowercase; } .ds-lang-dot { width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: #7ed5d0; box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(126, 213, 208, 0.6); }

components.name: Error State
components.description: Input error state. Coral border, coral message below.
components.html: Invalid email format
components.css: .ds-input-error-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-input-error { background: #0f0d0d; color: #f5f3f0; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; border: 2px solid #ff6b5b; border-radius: 0; outline: none; } .ds-error-msg { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ff6b5b; }

narrative.overview:
A magazine editor's workspace at 2am — editorial restraint, sharp tools, red pen marks. The interface feels like it was made by someone who cares deeply about craft, not a template shop. Dark, dense, and confident. Every pixel earns its place.

Buildmancer is a product surface first, but the brand voice is editorial. Marketing pages lean magazine: serif display type, asymmetric compositions, generous whitespace. Product screens are the opposite: information-dense, no wasted space, developers want to see more at once.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only, no toggle. Dark is the brand.
Blood-red is scarce — one red element per viewport on marketing.
Sharp corners everywhere (0px radius). No rounded cards.
Editorial typography: Bodoni Moda for display, Sora for body, JetBrains Mono for data.
Density where it matters: workspace screens are packed, marketing is spacious.
Motion is a scalpel: one orchestrated entrance per page, subtle opacity shifts on hover.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The primary accent (blood red) is used on ≤10% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point. If everything is highlighted, nothing is highlighted.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Data Rule
rules.body: Any string that represents a technical value (file paths, commit hashes, test counts, timestamps, language labels) is set in JetBrains Mono. This creates an instant visual hierarchy: serif for voice, sans for narrative, mono for facts.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover elevation, modal overlay, focus). If a card has a shadow, it's wrong.

dos: Do use blood red sparingly. One red element per viewport on marketing. Red = live, active, primary action only.
Do use serif italic for editorial emphasis in headlines and display text.
Do use mono for all technical data, labels, and metadata.
Do keep corners sharp (0px radius) everywhere. No exceptions.
Do use tonal layering for depth. Surface → surface-alt → bg-deep creates hierarchy without shadows.
Do use 2px borders for cards and containers. 1px is too thin for dark themes.
Do respect reduced motion. All animations should be subtle opacity/shift transitions.
donts: Don't use rounded corners on any component. No cards, no buttons, no inputs.
Don't use gradient text or gradient backgrounds. Banned by brand.
Don't use glassmorphism, blur-heavy cards, or neon gradients.
Don't use border-left accent stripes on cards or list items.
Don't use the hero-metric template (big number + small label + gradient accent).
Don't use identical card grids with icon + heading + paragraph triptychs.
Don't look like a bootcamp site (Platzi, freeCodeCamp, Codecademy).
Don't use purple-blue gradients, cyan accents, or 'AI startup aesthetic.'
Don't use social login buttons on auth screens. This is a private club, not a SaaS tool.
Don't use em dashes in copy. Use commas, colons, semicolons, or periods.
